summary: Cursor resource teardown. Clears the active cursor via SetCursor(0), then iterates six handle slots starting at this+0x30 (20-byte stride), destroying each non-null handle through DestroyCursor and zeroing the slot. Finally resets the cursor count/index at this[42] (offset 0xA8) to 0 and returns the last destroyed or held handle. Called from HWInput_Exit and sub_4963D0.

local_names.this: cursor-manager object holding the handle array and the cursor count
local_names.v2: pointer walking the six handle slots, advancing 20 bytes per iteration
local_names.result: accumulated HCURSOR value (last destroyed handle, or last slot value when null)

operations.description: Walk six handle slots starting at this[12] (offset 0x30), advancing the pointer by 20 bytes (5 dwords) per iteration
Destroy a slot only when its handle value is non-null
Destroy the slot's handle via DestroyCursor and zero the slot entry
Returns the accumulated handle value (last destroyed handle, or the last slot value when null); called from the input-exit path HWInput_Exit and from sub_4963D0
